programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: This dazzling film noir from Stanley Kubrick is about a struggling New York boxer (Jamie Smith), whose life is imperiled when he protects a nightclub dancer (Irene Kane) from her gangster boss.

programme.title: Shooter

programme.title: Cabin Fever

programme.title: The Killing
programme.desc: With fascinating detail, Stanley Kubrick lays bare the intricate inner-planning of a racetrack heist by a deadly mastermind (Sterling Hayden) and his crew. Co-stars Coleen Gray.

programme.title: Paths Of Glory
programme.desc: This powerful, fact-based absurdity-of-war film stars Kirk Douglas as a commanding officer who defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.desc: Legends Kirk Douglas, Tony Curtis, Ernest Borgnine and Janet Leigh dazzle in this epic chronicle of brutal rivalry and bloodthirsty ambition as two brothers are locked in a battle that will decide their fate...and that of a beautiful princess.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: Deliver Us from Evil (2014)
programme.desc: A NYPD officer (Eric Bana) and unconventional priest Mendoza (Edgar Ramírez) who join forces to investigate a series of disturbing & inexplicable crimes. Together, they must combat the possessions that are terrorizing their city before it's too late.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair face an even bigger threat lurking below the surface.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic that has spread around the world.

programme.title: Gang Related
programme.desc: Corrupt detectives Tupac Shakur and James Belushi, having framed an innocent man (Dennis Quaid) for the murder of an undercover DEA agent, find their lives unraveling when they come under the scrutiny of DEA investigator Richard Simms (Gary Cole).

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal gun battle, Marcus recalls his journey from orphaned street kid from the Bronx to making his mark in the drug trade to teaming up with a fellow ex-con (Terrence Howard) for his shot at becoming a successful rap artist.

programme.title: Enter the Ninja
programme.desc: The absorbing martial arts film that exposes Ninjutsu, the lethal, little-known "Art of Invisibility"... which includes the use of hypnotism, explosives, and super-human fighting skills.

programme.title: Revenge of the Ninja
programme.desc: Sho Kosugi ("Enter the Ninja") delivers a heart-pounding display of strength, speed and lethal Ninja know-how in this action-packed thriller that takes us back to the good old days of the Kung Fu extravaganza.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Encino Man
programme.desc: Two high school buddies dig up a frozen caveman in their backyard!

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Two top secret agents (Will Smith and Tommy Lee Jones) are on a mission of policing alien activities on planet Earth. The Men in Black's current assignment: to stop an intergalactic terrorist from making Earth his next victim.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Agents Jay and Kay are re-teamed against a sinister seductress who represents the toughest challenge yet to the MIB.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Julie & Julia, tells the true stories of how Julia Child's life and cookbook inspired fledgling writer Julie Powell to whip up 524 recipes in 365 days and introduce a new generation to the magic of French cooking.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: When Shelley gets kicked out of the mansion, she's lost in the wilds of Beverly Hills until she stumbles upon the sorriest sorority on campus. Now it's up to her to spruce up the girls and heat up the Zeta house before the University shuts them down.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: Beca, Fat Amy, and the Barden Bellas compete in the World Championships of A Cappella after a scandal threatens their legacy.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Matt Damon plays Rudy Baylor, a rookie lawyer in over his head on a high-profile case. Opposing him: an army of legal sharks. On Rudy’s side: Deck Shifflet, a feisty “paralawyer” who specializes in flunking the bar exam.

programme.title: Identity
programme.desc: What if every choice we ever make was already made for us? What if there really were no coincidences in life and our destinies were already predetermined? Ten strangers with secrets are brought together in a savage rainstorm. Rated: R

programme.title: Inland Empire
programme.desc: As an actress begins to adopt the persona of her character in a film, her world becomes nightmarish and surreal.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Beautiful Boy
programme.desc: Bill (Michael Sheen) and Kate’s (Maria Bello) already strained marriage is tested when their college-age son commits a shocking act of violence that reverberates across the country.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman and Wes Studi as Geronimo, giving a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Lara Croft sets out on a quest to save Pandora's box from landing into the wrong hands. Join her as she races through furious hand-to-hand battles, blazing shoot-outs and breathtaking sky-diving escapes to try to save the ancient artifact.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

programme.title: Child's Play (2019)
programme.desc: In this shocking re-imagining of the horror classic, single mother Karen (Aubrey Plaza) buys her son Andy (Gabriel Bateman) a seemingly innocent, AI-enhanced Buddi doll, unaware of its more sinister nature…and its true name…Chucky!

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: Cooties

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.desc: Legends Kirk Douglas, Tony Curtis, Ernest Borgnine and Janet Leigh dazzle in this epic chronicle of brutal rivalry and bloodthirsty ambition as two brothers are locked in a battle that will decide their fate...and that of a beautiful princess.

programme.title: Detective Story
programme.desc: Kirk Douglas stars as the rigid detective whose personal code has become twisted from dealing with too many criminals. Eleanor Parker is his wife, tormented by a guilty secret.

programme.title: Hamlet
programme.desc: Prince Hamlet struggles over whether or not he should kill his uncle, whom he suspects has murdered his father, the former king.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic that has spread around the world.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two crew members wake up on an abandoned spacecraft without knowing who they are, how long they've been asleep, or their mission. Soon after, they discover they're not alone, and the situation is more horrifying than they ever could have imagined.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal gun battle, Marcus recalls his journey from orphaned street kid from the Bronx to making his mark in the drug trade to teaming up with a fellow ex-con (Terrence Howard) for his shot at becoming a successful rap artist.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Black Eagle
programme.desc: When one of the US Air Force’s most modern tactical aircraft crashes in the sea near Malta, the CIA dispatches their best agent to salvage the plane's advanced weapons system before it falls into enemy hands.

programme.title: Enter the Ninja
programme.desc: The absorbing martial arts film that exposes Ninjutsu, the lethal, little-known "Art of Invisibility"... which includes the use of hypnotism, explosives, and super-human fighting skills.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Agents Jay and Kay are re-teamed against a sinister seductress who represents the toughest challenge yet to the MIB.

programme.title: Men in Black³
programme.desc: Agent Jay travels back in time to 1969, where he teams up with a younger version of Agent Kay to stop an evil alien from destroying the future.

programme.title: For Now
programme.desc: Still grieving the death of their parents while trying to build a future for themselves, two siblings take a road trip up the California coast for a ballet audition.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: Beca, Fat Amy, and the Barden Bellas compete in the World Championships of A Cappella after a scandal threatens their legacy.

programme.title: Save The Last Dance
programme.desc: Sara is a small-town girl who dreams to become a world-class ballerina. But when her mother suddenly dies, she must abandon her plans and join her estranged father on Chicago's South Side.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: Identity
programme.desc: What if every choice we ever make was already made for us? What if there really were no coincidences in life and our destinies were already predetermined? Ten strangers with secrets are brought together in a savage rainstorm. Rated: R

programme.title: Inland Empire
programme.desc: As an actress begins to adopt the persona of her character in a film, her world becomes nightmarish and surreal.

programme.title: I Saw the TV Glow
programme.desc: Introduced to a mysterious late-night TV show—a vision of a secret, supernatural world beneath his life in the suburbs—teenage Owen's reality begins to crack. A once-in-a-generation horror from Jane Schoenbrun.

programme.title: Blue Ruin
programme.desc: BLUE RUIN is a classic American revenge story, following a mysterious outsider whose quiet life is turned upside down when he returns to his childhood home, determined to carry out an act of vengeance.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Beautiful Boy
programme.desc: Bill (Michael Sheen) and Kate’s (Maria Bello) already strained marriage is tested when their college-age son commits a shocking act of violence that reverberates across the country.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Damsel
programme.desc: A businessman travels West to join his fiancée in the mountains.

programme.title: The Conspirator
programme.desc: From director Robert Redford comes the riveting true story behind the assassination trial of Abraham Lincoln – including the lone woman who was accused of plotting his murder.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: Academy Award-winner Charlize Theron stars as Aeon Flux, the underground operative fighting totalitarian rule in 25th-century Earth's last living city.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Staying Alive takes Saturday Night Fever’s Tony Manero out of Brooklyn to Broadway. As a wannabe dancer struggling to make it on the stage, John Travolta is at his sexy, sizzling best.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: How to Talk to Girls At Parties
programme.desc: Worlds collide when Enn, a shy teenager in 70s London, meets the beautiful and rebellious Zan (Elle Fanning) at a party. They set in motion the ultimate showdown between their rivaling worlds and test the limits of how far they will go for true love.

programme.title: Obvious Child
programme.desc: A one night stand leaves a woman (Jenny Slate) with an unexpected surprise just in time for Valentine's Day in this hilarious and heartwarming romantic comedy that has critics audiences raving.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: Carrie (2013)
programme.desc: Chloë Grace Moretz and Julianne Moore star in this exhilarating reimagining of Stephen King's iconic best-seller, 'Carrie.' After merciless taunting and abuse, events spiral out of control until the terrifying conclusion of this horror story.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: This confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone, and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

programme.title: Big

programme.title: Hamlet
programme.desc: Prince Hamlet struggles over whether or not he should kill his uncle, whom he suspects has murdered his father, the former king.

programme.title: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
programme.desc: Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two crew members wake up on an abandoned spacecraft without knowing who they are, how long they've been asleep, or their mission. Soon after, they discover they're not alone, and the situation is more horrifying than they ever could have imagined.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair face an even bigger threat lurking below the surface.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal gun battle, Marcus recalls his journey from orphaned street kid from the Bronx to making his mark in the drug trade to teaming up with a fellow ex-con (Terrence Howard) for his shot at becoming a successful rap artist.

programme.title: Enter the Ninja
programme.desc: The absorbing martial arts film that exposes Ninjutsu, the lethal, little-known "Art of Invisibility"... which includes the use of hypnotism, explosives, and super-human fighting skills.

programme.title: Revenge of the Ninja
programme.desc: Sho Kosugi ("Enter the Ninja") delivers a heart-pounding display of strength, speed and lethal Ninja know-how in this action-packed thriller that takes us back to the good old days of the Kung Fu extravaganza.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: For Now
programme.desc: Still grieving the death of their parents while trying to build a future for themselves, two siblings take a road trip up the California coast for a ballet audition.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Canadian Bacon
programme.desc: Falling approval ratings and a sagging economy, cause a desperate U.S. president to turn America against its most unlikely enemy, Canada. A Niagara Falls sheriff and his band of misfit deputies invade Canada leaving the President's plans in shambles.

programme.title: Save The Last Dance
programme.desc: Sara is a small-town girl who dreams to become a world-class ballerina. But when her mother suddenly dies, she must abandon her plans and join her estranged father on Chicago's South Side.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: John Clark is a meek workaholic who feels trapped in a dull, mind-numbing existence. One night, his whole life changes after the sight of a beautiful dance instructor inspire him to break out of his mold and sign up for some fancy footwork.

programme.title: Inland Empire
programme.desc: As an actress begins to adopt the persona of her character in a film, her world becomes nightmarish and surreal.

programme.title: I Saw the TV Glow
programme.desc: Introduced to a mysterious late-night TV show—a vision of a secret, supernatural world beneath his life in the suburbs—teenage Owen's reality begins to crack. A once-in-a-generation horror from Jane Schoenbrun.

programme.title: Blue Ruin
programme.desc: BLUE RUIN is a classic American revenge story, following a mysterious outsider whose quiet life is turned upside down when he returns to his childhood home, determined to carry out an act of vengeance.

programme.title: Terminal
programme.desc: Two assassins carrying out a sinister mission, a teacher battling a fatal illness, an enigmatic janitor and a waitress leading a dangerous double life.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Damsel
programme.desc: A businessman travels West to join his fiancée in the mountains.

programme.title: The Conspirator
programme.desc: From director Robert Redford comes the riveting true story behind the assassination trial of Abraham Lincoln – including the lone woman who was accused of plotting his murder.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: Academy Award-winner Charlize Theron stars as Aeon Flux, the underground operative fighting totalitarian rule in 25th-century Earth's last living city.

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Anne Hathaway stars in an unforgettable, modern fairy tale in which a girl's given the gift of obedience by her Fairy Godmother. An amazing, magical adventure bursting with colorful characters, music, wit, and whimsy.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Staying Alive takes Saturday Night Fever’s Tony Manero out of Brooklyn to Broadway. As a wannabe dancer struggling to make it on the stage, John Travolta is at his sexy, sizzling best.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Obvious Child
programme.desc: A one night stand leaves a woman (Jenny Slate) with an unexpected surprise just in time for Valentine's Day in this hilarious and heartwarming romantic comedy that has critics audiences raving.

programme.title: Dicks: The Musical
programme.desc: Two self-obsessed businessmen discover they're identical twins and plot to reunite their eccentric divorced parents. A riotously funny and debaucherous musical starring Megan Thee Stallion, Nathan Lane, Megan Mullally, and Bowen Yang.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Stephen King's A Good Marriage
programme.desc: With a serial killer on the loose and a stranger stalking her family, a dedicated wife unveils a sinister secret about her husband that threatens their marriage, and their lives.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: This confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone, and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

programme.title: Big
programme.desc: In this heartfelt comedy starring Tom Hanks, a young boy discovers adulthood isn't all it's cracked up to be when his wish to be a grown-up magically comes true.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father Dusty (Wahlberg) shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)
programme.desc: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Living under three months' house arrest, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passes his days spying on the neighbors. It's all fun and games until things take a horrifying turn for the worse.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes and wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

programme.title: Colors
programme.desc: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a veteran cop and his new partner are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the barrios and slums of East Los Angeles.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: They Call Me Bruce?
programme.desc: A goofy Korean finds his life hopelessly complicated when people continually confusing him with Bruce Lee while he unknowingly transports cocaine across the country.

programme.title: Dicks: The Musical
programme.desc: Two self-obsessed businessmen discover they're identical twins and plot to reunite their eccentric divorced parents. A riotously funny and debaucherous musical starring Megan Thee Stallion, Nathan Lane, Megan Mullally, and Bowen Yang.

programme.title: Swiss Army Man
programme.desc: Hank (Paul Dano) is stranded on a deserted island and given up all hope. Everything changes when a corpse (Daniel Radcliffe) washes ashore. They become fast friends and go on an epic adventure to bring Hank back to the woman of his dreams.

programme.title: Encino Man

programme.title: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
programme.desc: Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.

programme.title: Boeing-Boeing
programme.desc: Boeing Boeing follows the lives of journalist Bernard and his friend Robert. Bernard is juggling romances with three different stewardesses but when Robert comes in for a visit and the airline carriers increase flights to Paris the comedy ensues!

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair face an even bigger threat lurking below the surface.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic that has spread around the world.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: For a birthday celebration, three couples partake in an ESCAPE ROOM, in which they must work together to solve puzzles in order to escape the room—but when the game turns deadly, they quickly learn the only winners are the survivors.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal gun battle, Marcus recalls his journey from orphaned street kid from the Bronx to making his mark in the drug trade to teaming up with a fellow ex-con (Terrence Howard) for his shot at becoming a successful rap artist.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Black Eagle
programme.desc: When one of the US Air Force’s most modern tactical aircraft crashes in the sea near Malta, the CIA dispatches their best agent to salvage the plane's advanced weapons system before it falls into enemy hands.

programme.title: Ninja
programme.desc: A Westerner named Casey, studying Ninjutsu in Japan, is asked by the Sensei to return to New York to protect the legendary Yoroi Bitsu, an armored chest containing the weapons of the last Koga Ninja.

programme.title: Canadian Bacon
programme.desc: Falling approval ratings and a sagging economy, cause a desperate U.S. president to turn America against its most unlikely enemy, Canada. A Niagara Falls sheriff and his band of misfit deputies invade Canada leaving the President's plans in shambles.

programme.title: Summer Rental
programme.desc: Comedy sensation John Candy plays the stressed-out air traffic controller whose much-needed family holiday yields one hysterical misadventure after another.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: John Clark is a meek workaholic who feels trapped in a dull, mind-numbing existence. One night, his whole life changes after the sight of a beautiful dance instructor inspire him to break out of his mold and sign up for some fancy footwork.

programme.title: Bewitched (2005)
programme.desc: A has-been actor tries to convince the perfect woman to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series; a woman who, unbeknownst to him, really is a witch!

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: Blue Ruin
programme.desc: BLUE RUIN is a classic American revenge story, following a mysterious outsider whose quiet life is turned upside down when he returns to his childhood home, determined to carry out an act of vengeance.

programme.title: Terminal
programme.desc: Two assassins carrying out a sinister mission, a teacher battling a fatal illness, an enigmatic janitor and a waitress leading a dangerous double life.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Beautiful Boy
programme.desc: Bill (Michael Sheen) and Kate’s (Maria Bello) already strained marriage is tested when their college-age son commits a shocking act of violence that reverberates across the country.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Sanctified
programme.desc: A thrilling Western set in 1890 North Dakota, 'Sanctified' is the tale of an outlaw rescued from death by a nun traveling the Badlands. A deep friendship develops as she nurses the man back to health in exchange for his guidance at a local church.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven (2016)
programme.desc: Director Antoine Fuqua brings his modern vision to the classic western, a story of seven outlaws who join together to save a town from an evil industrialist! Denzel Washington, Chris Pratt, Ethan Hawke and Vincent D'Onofrio and Peter Sarsgaard star!

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: In hopes of wooing a girl, Tristan promises to bring her a falling star. He soon discovers the star is actually a celestial beauty named Yvaine. When an old witch Lamia attempts to steal Yvaine's youth, Tristan must protect her.

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Anne Hathaway stars in an unforgettable, modern fairy tale in which a girl's given the gift of obedience by her Fairy Godmother. An amazing, magical adventure bursting with colorful characters, music, wit, and whimsy.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Staying Alive takes Saturday Night Fever’s Tony Manero out of Brooklyn to Broadway. As a wannabe dancer struggling to make it on the stage, John Travolta is at his sexy, sizzling best.

programme.title: Boeing-Boeing
programme.desc: Boeing Boeing follows the lives of journalist Bernard and his friend Robert. Bernard is juggling romances with three different stewardesses but when Robert comes in for a visit and the airline carriers increase flights to Paris the comedy ensues!

programme.title: Rock-A-Bye Baby
programme.desc: A TV repairman marries a Mexican bullfighter. Unfortunately, he dies the day after their wedding; fortunately, he managed to impregnate her. Unfortunately, she is starring in the epic called The White Virgin on the Nile.

programme.title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World
programme.desc: Spencer Tracy leads a hilariously zany cast of Hollywood's greatest comedians (including Milton Berle, Sid Caesar, Ethel Merman and Mickey Rooney) as eight vacation-bound motorists set off on a mad-cap, side-splitting race to find a stolen fortune!

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: For a birthday celebration, three couples partake in an ESCAPE ROOM, in which they must work together to solve puzzles in order to escape the room—but when the game turns deadly, they quickly learn the only winners are the survivors.

programme.title: Catacombs
programme.desc: Horror unfolds when a naïve American makes her first trip to Paris and is invited to an underground rave party in the city's catacombs.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two crew members wake up on an abandoned spacecraft without knowing who they are, how long they've been asleep, or their mission. Soon after, they discover they're not alone, and the situation is more horrifying than they ever could have imagined.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal gun battle, Marcus recalls his journey from orphaned street kid from the Bronx to making his mark in the drug trade to teaming up with a fellow ex-con (Terrence Howard) for his shot at becoming a successful rap artist.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Ninja
programme.desc: A Westerner named Casey, studying Ninjutsu in Japan, is asked by the Sensei to return to New York to protect the legendary Yoroi Bitsu, an armored chest containing the weapons of the last Koga Ninja.

programme.title: Ninja: Shadow Of A Tear
programme.desc: Ninjutsu master Casey is back and out for revenge when his pregnant wife is murdered.

programme.title: One More Shot
programme.desc: A Navy SEAL fights off airport terrorists planning to bomb the State of the Union address.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Two top secret agents (Will Smith and Tommy Lee Jones) are on a mission of policing alien activities on planet Earth. The Men in Black's current assignment: to stop an intergalactic terrorist from making Earth his next victim.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Agents Jay and Kay are re-teamed against a sinister seductress who represents the toughest challenge yet to the MIB.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: America's Sweethearts
programme.desc: For Kiki (Julia Roberts), being the personal assistant to the beautiful megastar, Gwen (Catherine Zeta-Jones), isn't easy. In fact, it's nearly impossible since the man of her dreams is Eddie (John Cusack), Gwen's estranged husband.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: John Clark is a meek workaholic who feels trapped in a dull, mind-numbing existence. One night, his whole life changes after the sight of a beautiful dance instructor inspire him to break out of his mold and sign up for some fancy footwork.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: Mitch joins a prosperous Memphis firm that affords Mitch and his wife an affluent lifestyle beyond their wildest dreams. But when FBI agents confront him with evidence of corruption and murder within the firm, Mitch sets out to find the truth.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Beautiful Boy
programme.desc: Bill (Michael Sheen) and Kate’s (Maria Bello) already strained marriage is tested when their college-age son commits a shocking act of violence that reverberates across the country.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven (2016)
programme.desc: Director Antoine Fuqua brings his modern vision to the classic western, a story of seven outlaws who join together to save a town from an evil industrialist! Denzel Washington, Chris Pratt, Ethan Hawke and Vincent D'Onofrio and Peter Sarsgaard star!

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman and Wes Studi as Geronimo, giving a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Anne Hathaway stars in an unforgettable, modern fairy tale in which a girl's given the gift of obedience by her Fairy Godmother. An amazing, magical adventure bursting with colorful characters, music, wit, and whimsy.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: In hopes of wooing a girl, Tristan promises to bring her a falling star. He soon discovers the star is actually a celestial beauty named Yvaine. When an old witch Lamia attempts to steal Yvaine's youth, Tristan must protect her.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Staying Alive takes Saturday Night Fever’s Tony Manero out of Brooklyn to Broadway. As a wannabe dancer struggling to make it on the stage, John Travolta is at his sexy, sizzling best.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer.

programme.title: Romeo is Bleeding
programme.desc: In the faded past of his youth, patrolling was an important job but now Sgt. Jack Grimaldi sees that life on the other side of the binoculars has a little something extra—extra sex, extra money, extra excitement. Gary Oldman stars in this neo-noir.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes and wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

programme.title: The Babadook
programme.desc: In this terrifying thriller, a mother must protect her son from an evil, supernatural entity that has escaped the pages of a children's book and is lurking in their home.

programme.title: George A. Romero's Survival of the Dead
programme.desc: The final film from George A. Romero (legendary creator of the Night of the Living Dead franchise) picks up where Diary of the Dead leaves off - in a nightmarish world where humans are the minority and the zombies rule.

programme.title: Hell House LLC.
programme.desc: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: The rules for a Mogwai are simple: Keep your Mogwai away from water, bright lights and, most importantly, never feed him after midnight. But in Kingston Falls the rules are broken, and the consequences multiply at an alarming rate.

programme.title: Big
programme.desc: In this heartfelt comedy starring Tom Hanks, a young boy discovers adulthood isn't all it's cracked up to be when his wish to be a grown-up magically comes true.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Sinvergüenzas

programme.title: El Rayo de Sinaloa

programme.title: Una Gallega En La Habana

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine

programme.desc: La banda del pueblo engañan a Heidi dándole un pan de la tienda a cambio de su fósil, el tendero al darse cuenta llama a Heidi ladrona, ahora Pedro y Heidi deben hacer que Theresa y Karl digan la verdad.

programme.title: Heidi: Atrapados en la mansión
programme.desc: Theresa y Karl acusan a Pedro de que la maestra los castigo por su culpa, deciden atacar a Heidi y Pedro hasta que llegan a la antigua mansión del abuelo, en el ático quedan atrapadas Heidi y Theresa, los chicos deben unirse para ayudarlas.

programme.title: Heidi: Cuidado con el lobo
programme.desc: Una cabra es atacada mientras Heidi se encuentra un cachorro, lo que no sabe es que es un pequeño Lobo. En el pueblo vaga una loba que acaba de atacar a una cabra y el pueblo teme por que sean atacados.

programme.title: Heidi: El tesoro de Pedro
programme.desc: La primavera ya regreso y Pedro y Heidi están listos para abrir la casa del árbol, se da cuenta Pedro que su tesoro no esta, ellos sabe quienes fueron, el abuelo les aconseja un plan para que los delincuentes confiesen.

programme.title: Heidi: Ataque en la casa del árbol
programme.desc: William, Karl y Theresa toman la casa del árbol, furioso Pedro quiere usar la fuerza para sacarlos, pero Heidi tiene un plan más creativo para espantar a los chicos de la casa del árbol.

programme.title: Heidi: Salvando a Encanto
programme.desc: La pequeña cabra que fue atacada por el Lobo ya no quiere dar leche, los dueños quieren sacrificarla, pero Heidi hace un último intento con amor para que la cabra vuelva a dar leche. ¿lo logrará?

programme.title: Heidi: El fin de la primavera
programme.desc: La tía de Heidi regresa al pueblo para llevarse a Heidi a Frankfurt, el abuelo se niega a dejarla ir, después de una discusión con la tía accede que se lleven a Heidi. Pedro y el abuelo no quieren que se vaya.

programme.title: Heidi: Clara
programme.desc: A la llegada de Heidi a Frankfurt será compañera de una niña llamada Clara que esta en una silla de ruedas.

programme.title: Heidi: El campanario
programme.desc: Heidi quiere subir al campanario para ver si logra ver las montañas, desafortunadamente no puede pero encuentra 2 gatitos uno para ella y otro para Clara los cuales deben esconder de la señorita Rottenmeier.

programme.title: Heidi: La promesa
programme.desc: La señorita Rottenmeier es alérgica a los gatos, pide a Sebastian que los ahogue y encierra a Heidi en el sotano como castigo. Clara ayuda a que Heidi escape para salvar a los gatitos.

programme.desc: Vaya en un placentero viaje mientras un artista crea dibujos en arena; títeres de sombras cuentan la historia de un gato rescatado; y otras aventuras.

programme.title: Vocabulario y Números con Harry el Conejo
programme.desc: Hoy, Harry explora todo tipo de cosas dentro y fuera de casa. Su hijo se familiarizará con el color azul, la zanahoria y mucho más.

programme.title: Inspiración de color - Arte y música
programme.desc: Este divertido bloque incluye una representación artística de las frutas saludables como una zanahoria y una manzana; sonidos de la calle con La Osita Bonnie; y más.

programme.title: Inspiración de color - Arte y música
programme.desc: Este bloque incluye el cuadro de una vela brillante; una escena en la playa hecha de plastilina; y mucho más.

programme.title: Inspiración de color - Arte y música
programme.desc: Hoy La Osita Bonnie emprende un viaje a la granja; un picnic de plastilina cobra vida; y un hermoso cuadro de un padre y su hijo es pintado.

programme.title: Clase de bebé: Vocabulario y números
programme.desc: Clase de Bebé ayuda a introducir a sus bebés y niños pequeños a palabras y a bases preescolares. Hoy conocerán nuevos vehículos y se unirán a Fred y Fiona, Harry y Larry, Al y más.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Entra Naruto Uzumaki!
programme.desc: Bienvenidos a la Aldea Escondida entre las Hojas, donde los ninjas deambulan por todas partes y el travieso Naruto Uzumaki causa problemas. Pero cuando roba el antiguo Pergamino del Sello, ¡desata un extraño poder nada común en un muchacho de 12 años!

programme.title: Naruto: Mi Nombre Es Konohamaru
programme.desc: Naruto al fin consigue graduarse de la Academia Ninja y afirma saberlo todo. Al menos, eso es lo que le dice a Konohamaru, el pequeño nieto del anciano de la aldea.

programme.title: Naruto: Sasuke Y Sakura: ¿Amigos O Enemigos?
programme.desc: Naruto forma equipo con sus compañeros de clase: Sakura y Sasuke. Lo único que tienen en común sus compañeros es que ambos lo odian, por lo que Naruto trata de ganarse a Sakura fingiendo ser la persona que siempre le ha gustado… ¡Sasuke!

programme.title: Naruto: Aprobar o reprobar un Examen De Supervivencia
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura son un equipo, se encuentran con su sensei, Kakashi, él propondrá un examen que solo dos de ellos pueden aprobar, enviando al estudiante que falla a la Academia Ninja. ¡Ellos no saben que alguien haya pasado la prueba de Kakashi!

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Fallaste! La Decisión Final De Kakashi
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura hacen todo lo posible para aprobar el examen de supervivencia. ¡Pero serán necesarios los sabios consejos de Kakashi para enseñarles a estos ninjas egoístas lo que significa trabajar en equipo!

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Una Misión Peligrosa! Un Viaje A La Tierra De Las Olas
programme.desc: Naruto y sus compañeros comienzan sus primeras misiones ninja. Son tareas aburridas, enojadas y frustradas, y Naruto se alivia diciéndole todo al Hokage. Entretenido por el entusiasmo de Naruto, les asigna una nueva misión: proteger al viejo Tazuna.

programme.title: Naruto: El Asesino De La Neblina
programme.desc: Naruto y su grupo llegan a Tierra de las Olas,donde un malvado hombre llamado Gato se apodero del lugar. Allí aparece Zabuza, contratado por Gato para matar a Tazuna. Naruto está deseando enfrentarse a este asesino ninja. ¿Estará listo para este desafío?

programme.title: Naruto: El Juramento Del Dolor
programme.desc: Kakashi se pone delante durante la batalla contra Zabuza. Pero ¡todo cambia cuando Kakashi es atrapado en la Prisión de Agua de Zabuza! Kakashi pide que huyan, pero Naruto recuerda la promesa que hizo -no volver a huir nunca más- y se mantiene firme!

programme.title: Naruto: Kakashi: Guerrero Sharingan
programme.desc: Gracias al plan de Naruto, Kakashi se libera de la Prisión de Agua y derrota a Zabuza. Un misterioso ninja aparece de repente y acaba con Zabuza antes de que Kakashi lo haga. Naruto se sorprende al ver que un muchacho ha podido derrotar a Zabuza.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan tiene una cita con Brianna y ella llega con un suéter blanco que le tejió su abuela antes de morir. Pero cuando Kel derrama soda de naranja en el suéter, los muchachos entran en pánico y se pasan toda la noche tratando de limpiarlo.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Mientras están viendo un programa de investigación de delitos, Kenan y Kel se convencen de que el padre de Kenan es un ladrón conocido como el “Bandido Diamante”, e intentan devolver lo que ellos creen que son los diamantes robados.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel tiene un resfriado, y Kenan decide preparar un remedio casero, usando pollo, huevos, sardinas, malvaviscos y gaseosa de naranja. Para su sorpresa, Kel se cura y ahora Kenan tiene que acordarse de la receta, cuando su papá se enferma.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan salva la vida del presidente de los Estados Unidos y es invitado a la Casa Blanca, en donde Kel, accidentalmente, destruye una fotografía muy valiosa.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan intenta invitar a una chica a una cita, que resulta ser la hija del jefe de su padre, el Sr. Dawson, pero en el proceso, Kenan y Kel dejan un mensaje escandaloso en su buzón de mensajes.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan ha ahorrado suficiente dinero para comprar una nueva bicicleta justo a tiempo para Navidad, pero ¿gastará ese dinero solo para él? ¿O habrá un espacio en su corazón para el espíritu navideño?

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan entra en pánico cuando la directora de la escuela pide una reunión con él y sus padres. Pensando que hizo algo malo, decide contratar a dos actores para que hagan de sus padres durante la cita.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Es el Día de Acción de Gracias y el padre de Kenan ha preparado un pavo. Pero cuando nadie está en la cocina, Kel no puede resistir la tentación y se devora el pavo en cuestión de minutos. Ahora Kenan y Kel están en grandes problemas.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una maestra sustituta en la clase y Kel está seguro de que ella está enamorada de Kenan. Kenan no le cree al principio, pero Kel es persistente y persuasivo. Comienza a convencer a Kenan de que puede tener razón.

programme.title: ¡Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
programme.desc: Mientras Playmaker se enfrenta al misterioso oponente brillante, acaba descubriendo su verdadera identidad, la cual incluye una gran sorpresa. Pero no es el único personaje que lo sorprenderá en este episodio.

programme.title: ¡Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
programme.desc: Soulburner se enfrenta en duelo a Bit y Boot, quienes se fusionan para ponerlo en aprietos. Mientras, Playmaker se pregunta quién es este nuevo personaje y por qué tiene un Ignis de fuego.

programme.title: ¡Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
programme.desc: Un nuevo alumno aparece en la escuela y parece saber quién es Playmaker, con lo que se acercará a él. ¿Con qué intenciones?

programme.title: ¡Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
programme.desc: Go Onizuka se deshizo de su nombre y su fama para convertirse en cazarrecompensas de SOL Technologies con la esperanza de derrotar a Playmaker, pero es Soulburner quien sale a su paso.

programme.title: ¡Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
programme.desc: El espíritu del Millennium Puzzle se da cuenta de que sus recuerdos del antiguo Egipto se han desvanecido, pero Tea lo ayuda a descubrir los misterios de su pasado.

programme.title: ¡Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
programme.desc: Mientras Playmaker enfrenta al durísimo Blood Shepherd, Blue Angel y Ghost Girl buscan a las Ignis en un lugar donde podrían estar escondidas.

programme.title: ¡Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
programme.desc: Playmaker enfrenta al duro cazarrecompensas Blood Shepherd en un duelo en el que su enemigo parece tener controlada su habilidad.

programme.title: ¡Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
programme.desc: Playmaker y Soulburner se encuentran con el Ignis del Viento, a quien explican qué están buscando y piden su ayuda. Este no está dispuesto a confiar en los humanos fácilmente, y a cambio de su ayuda pedirá a ambos que se encarguen de dos infiltradas.

programme.title: ¡Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
programme.desc: Chica Azul enfrenta a Soulburner en un duro combate donde intentará demostrar cuánto ha mejorado con su nuevo deck.

programme.title: ¡Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
programme.desc: Playmaker se encuentra con Bohman, quien quiere combatir contra él. En el combate le revelará algo aterrador.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Érase una vez, un evento de videojuegos tan grande, que todo el mundo quería estar en él nos referimos al E3, y en Expansion Pack nos pondremos nostálgicos para recordar cómo era este show. Como broche de oro, honraremos obra de Shigeru Miyamoto.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En este Expansion Pack te presentaremos un top dedicado a algunas de las interpretaciones más memorables. Repasaremos la evolución de una de las sagas más emblemáticas de Xbox: Gears of War y te contaremos todo acerca del origen de adorable Kirby.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Veamos la historia de como SEGA creo a un simpatico personaje para competir contra el plomero de Nintendo. Esta es la historia detras de Sonic The Hedgehog.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Ni sus creadores imaginaban la clase de juego y el exito que tendria el juego que les tomo 7 anos desarrollar. Esta es la historia detras de Fortnite Battle Royale.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te narramos la creacion de una de las franquicias mas importantes para PlayStation la cual elevo a Naughty Dog a un estado de culto. Esta es la historia detras de: UNCHARTED: Drake's Fortune.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Revisamos la historia de Gears of War, una emblematica franquicia de Xbox que se estreno durante la septima generacion de consolas para Xbox 360.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Revisamos el FPS de guerra moderna que cambio la historia de los FPS. Esta es la historiad e Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: A lo largo de su historia, se han podido encontrar a los pequenos monstruos de bolsillo en todos lados, desde videojuegos, tiendas, etc. Hoy veremos la historia detras de la fiebre amarilla: Pokemon

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: GTA V, el juego que cambio el paradigma de diseno de Rock Star Games. Tambien, resulto siendo uno de los titulos mas exitosos para la franquicia y uno de los videojuegos mas vendidos en la historia

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Revisamos la creacion del juego independiente desarrollado por Mojang y Markus Notch Persson que definio la ultima decada. Esta es la historia detras de Minecraft.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Revisamos la historia de uno de los oficios más populares de Mario, el de conductor de autos Go Kart.

programme.title: VG Chronicles
programme.desc: En Mega Man X6-X8, X enfrenta un nuevo brote Maverick, al científico Gate y a High Max, mientras busca a Zero. Surge Axl, con habilidad de copia. La saga evoluciona gráficamente y mejora en narrativa y jugabilidad.

programme.title: VG Chronicles
programme.desc: En un mundo donde los Reploids son perseguidos, Zero despierta para unirse a la resistencia contra Neo Arcadia.

programme.title: VG Chronicles
programme.desc: La saga Castlevania comienza con Leon Belmont en el siglo XI, quien tras perder a su amada se convierte en cazador de vampiros. Su amigo Mathias se convierte en Drácula, iniciando siglos de conflicto con los Belmont.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Zoro y Sanji atacan a Kuma, pero el Shichibukai repele todos sus ataques con las pezuñas de sus manos. Kuma contraataca con unos extraños ataques que tienen una potencia impresionante, y parece que los Sombrero de Paja están al borde de la aniquilación.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Tras el pedido de Kuma de que le entreguen la cabeza de Luffy a cambio de salvar a todos, Zoro decide entregar su propia cabeza para salvar a Luffy. Tras ver su gran determinación, Kuma decide emplear un método alternativo.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Kuma se retira tras la hazaña de Zoro. Luffy despierta y se alistan para abandonar Thriller Bark, no sin antes hacer una fiesta para celebrar su victoria. En el medio de la fiesta, Luffy vuelve a pedirle a Brook que sea su compañero.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Brook recuerda su pasado. Recuerda las aventuras que tuvo con los Piratas Rumbar y cómo conoció a Laboon.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Brook sigue recordando sus aventuras con los Piratas Rumbar. Tras entrar en el Grand Line, el capitán enferma y debe separarse de la tripulación. Más tarde, el resto de los piratas vuelve a caer, pero no sin antes dejar un recuerdo para su querido Laboon.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Terminan las celebraciones y los Sombrero de Paja vuelven a seguir su camino hacia la Isla Gyojin junto a su nuevo compañero: El músico, Brook.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Los Sombrero de Paja abandonan el Florian Triangle y arriban a un centro turístico llamado Spa Island para descansar. Mientras están ahí encuentran a un viejo conocido: el Zorro Plateado Foxy.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Tras el secuestro de Sayo los Sombrero de Paja deciden destruir el centro turístico para poder rescatarla. El lugar queda en muy mal estado, pero por fin pueden encontrar la clave para la fabricación de joyas.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Brook encuentra el cuaderno de bitácora de la tripulación y se entera sobre todas las aventuras que han tenido los Sombrero de Paja.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: ¡Comienzan las operaciones en tierra! ¡Los Sombrero de Paja van al ataque!
programme.desc: El Rocketman está llegando a Enies Lobby y los Sombrero de Paja planean cómo atacarla para poder rescatar a Robin y Franky.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: La tía de Yui, Sanako, quien también es propietaria de Atori, ha regresado de un largo viaje al extranjero. A Sanako, al conocer a Ren, no le gusta y lo interrumpe.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Sanako, la tía de Yui a la que le gusta mucho Shinji, intenta convencer a los tres (Ren, Yui y Shinji) de que vivan juntos, pero Ren no acepta el acercamiento de Shinji a Yui.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Shimada Nanako, el genio informático del ORE Journal, ha sido secuestrado. Shinji recibe instrucciones de encargarse de este incidente y persigue al secuestrador en una casa abandonada en las montañas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Naruto: El País Donde Existió un Héroe

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Batalla En El Puente! ¡Zabuza Regresa!
programme.desc: Mientras Naruto se concentra en el entrenamiento, una misteriosa figura aparece y le dice que si alguien tiene el deseo de proteger lo que ama, puede llegar a ser tan fuerte como quiera.

programme.title: Naruto: Las Armas Conocidas Como Shinobi

programme.title: Naruto: El Demonio De La Nieve
programme.desc: Naruto enfrenta a Zabuza. Aunque parece no tener emociones, Zabuza está desolado por la pérdida de Haku, la única persona del mundo en la que podía confiar. Naruto se da cuenta de que esta cruel realidad es el destino de los ninjas.

programme.title: Naruto: Un Nuevo Capítulo Comienza: El Examen Chunin
programme.desc: Naruto y compañia regresan a la Aldea Escondida entre las Hojas después de su batalla en la Tierra de las Olas. Aunque cumplen las misiones, Naruto no está satisfecho. Pronto descubre que los extraños están apareciendo en el Leaf Village.

programme.title: Naruto: Identifíquense: Nuevos Y Poderosos Rivales
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura son de los elegidos para tomar el Examen Chunin, pero Iruka se opone a que participen. Son muy jóvenes y carecen de la experiencia y habilidades necesarias. Kakashi piensa que están listos para afrontar el desafío.

programme.title: Naruto: Reto Chunin: Rock Lee Versus Sasuke

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Dil le habla a Angélica sobre el karma, luego de que ella venciera a Susie injustamente por un concierto de canto. Cuando Angélica se despierta con un grano gigante, se convence de que debe cambiar su actitud para que el grano desaparezca.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Tommy, Carlitos, Fili y Dil forman un equipo para competir contra Angélica en la Carrera Derby de Carros Armados. Ella se une solo porque cree que el ganador pasará a la final en París, Francia, cuando en realidad es en París, Texas.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Se acerca la Navidad, y Carlitos roba, por accidente, un hermoso árbolito para reemplazar el horrible que escogió su papá. Kira y Kimi están varadas en un aeropuerto. Tommy y Dil intentan escribir una memorable canción de Hanukkah.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Tommy, Fili y Lili faltan a la escuela para conseguir un autógrafo de su jugador de futbol favorito. Mientras tanto, Angélica, Susie y Carlitos participan en un proyecto escolar en donde aprenderán las responsabilidades del matrimonio.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: La fiesta de cumpleaños de Fili y Lili se aproxima, pero sus planes para una fiesta épica se destruyen cuando se dan cuenta de que están llegando a la adolescencia y de que tienen muchas diferencias entre sí.

programme.title: Naruto: La Décima Pregunta: Todo O Nada
programme.desc: La parte más difícil es la pregunta número 10. Antes de que escuchen la pregunta, Ibiki explica una regla muy severa: si responden mal a la pregunta, reprobarán el primer examen y el equipo perderá el derecho de tomar otros Exámenes en el futuro.

programme.title: Naruto: Reporte Especial: ¡En Vivo Desde El Bosque De La Muerte!
programme.desc: Konohamaru, el nieto del Tercer Hokage de la Aldea de la Hoja, aparece en el Examen, junto con Moegi y Udon, para cubrir los eventos en el periódico de la Academia Ninja. Konohamaru admira a Naruto y hace entrevistas a los personajes.

programme.title: Naruto: El Examen Chunin Segunda Etapa: El Bosque De La Muerte
programme.desc: Llegan al bosque de la Muerte, a la segunda parte del Examen. Cada equipo recibirá un pergamino. El equipo debe robar a otro equipo y después llegar a la torre con ambos pergaminos. La encargada del examen, Anko les da un consejo: “¡No se dejen matar!”

programme.title: Naruto: Comer O Ser Comido: Pánico En El Bosque
programme.desc: El segundo examen comienza. Sasuke se da cuenta de que un enemigo ha tomado la apariencia de Naruto y lo sigue. Sasuke rescata a Naruto, que estaba atado. Los tres compañeros de equipo deciden crear una contraseña por si vuelven a separarse de nuevo.

programme.title: Naruto: El contraataque de Naruto: Nunca Rendirse
programme.desc: El ninja que ataca a Sasuke y Sakura es muy poderoso. Sasuke casi entrega su pergamino, pero Naruto lo detiene de un golpe. La ira de Naruto crece al luchar, y su poder aflora. Entre tanto, la examinadora Anko descubre un problema sobre los participantes.

programme.title: Naruto: El Sharingan Revivido: Jutsu Flama De Dragón
programme.desc: Sasuke se da cuenta de que se equivocó al querer huir. Asumiendo el control de Naruto, Sasuke utiliza su Sharingan con toda su fuerza. El ninja se presenta como Orochimaru y desaparece, dejando una marca en el cuello de Sasuke.

programme.title: Naruto: La Promesa Del Cejudo: Amor Imperecedero Y Protección
programme.desc: Anko siente que Orochimaru se ha introducido en el examen y empieza a perseguirlo. Incluso con sus habilidades de jonin, es incapaz de detener al intruso. A pesar de estar agotada por la batalla, Sakura intenta detener al enemigo.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Sakura Florece!
programme.desc: Protegiendo a Sakura, que no puede moverse, Lee se enfrenta a los tres ninjas del sonidoen solitario. Utiliza su ataque sorpresa, pero no tiene efecto. Después de recibir golpes de Dosu, Lee se desploma. Sakura se pone en pie para defenderlos.
